hook.name: KlikHook
hook.description: A tiered fee hook for the Klik token launch platform on Tempo. Collects buy-side fees (0.10%–1.00% based on token market cap in USD) as ERC-6909 claims, then distributes them between a platform treasury and token creators. Includes anti-snipe protection that locks trading on the launch block and caps per-origin buys (in USD) during the first few blocks.
